C1.worst_defect: The hero itself is clean: a 'Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0' pill, the H1 'Point of sale for Vendure', two buttons and a large till screenshot. Below it, the 'Live demo or your own store' comparison table loses its Yes/Yes rhythm in two rows. The 'Refund a sale at the till' cell runs to 4 lines ('No, not on plugin 0.3.0: refund in the Vendure Dashboard. The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls; see Plugin setup'), and the last row also holds a long cell ('No: the demo store lives in your browser. All it sends is anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com, with no cookie'). The comparison stops reading at a glance.

C2.worst_defect: Honesty is shown in many places: the pre-release pill, the Limitations page ('Pre-release: expect changes before 1.0.'), the refund caveat and the telemetry disclosure. The only fault is placement: the long refund and telemetry caveats are packed into table cells on the home page instead of short Yes/No answers that link to the detail.

C3.worst_defect: Quick start is well structured: callouts, numbered steps 1–9, code blocks with copy buttons, and a 'Check it worked' list. The visual faults: inline code chips sit inside headings ('2. Add TallyPosPlugin to your existing Vendure config', 3 lines on phone), and chip padding reads as stray spaces ('( pricesIncludeTax: false )'). On phone, the sticky 'On this page' bar already shows '1. Install the plugin' before that heading is reached.

C4.worst_defect: Pages are consistent: sidebar, TOC, Copy Markdown and prev/next cards. Several are walls of text, though. On Troubleshooting, 'Act on a header notice' nests bold labels, bullets of quoted UI strings, 'At the counter:' / 'For the store owner:' sub-paragraphs, a collapsible and an errorCode list, about four levels deep. At the till slice 01 is about 8 H2 sections of prose with no image. The Changelog is almost all code chips ('Migration TallyPosV51790900000000 adds the v5 custom fields (order.tallyShipping, …').

C5.worst_defect: On the home page, 'What it does today' uses two different treatments. The first two features ('Keeps selling offline', 'Every sale lands once') are bordered cards with buttons, and their heights don't match: the right card has a large empty gap above 'Read the 200-send test'. The other 8 features are borderless heading-plus-paragraph pairs. On At the till, the cashier-sheet and closure figures are double-framed: an outer bordered box with wide grey padding wraps the inner screenshot card. Figure widths also vary (payment full width, cashier sheet about 420 px, closure about 545 px). Dark mode holds up well.

C6.worst_defect: No horizontal overflow, and the tables restack into labelled cards. On phone, the home hero till screenshot is cropped to a single product row, with the category chips cut mid-word ('Gif'), so the hero image shows almost nothing of the till. Inline code chips make line heights uneven in body text (e.g. 'Left empty, it allows no origins unless APP_ENV is dev…', and 'settleRefund' on Limitations).

C7.worst_defect: Lighthouse (mobile) scores 98/100/100/100 on / and 97/100/100/100 on quick-start, with CLS 0. JSON-LD, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap, robots, OG image and search API are all present, and the 404 page is a real 404 with links. Two small faults: the OG image's till screenshot is cut mid-card at the bottom edge ('In Stock' pills and 'Order discount' clipped), and Lighthouse still flags 53 KiB of unused JS and 150 ms of render-blocking resources.

overall_worst.defect: On the home page, 'What it does today' renders 2 of its 10 features as bordered cards with buttons, and those two cards have unequal heights (empty gap above 'Read the 200-send test'). The other 8 features are borderless text pairs, so the site's main feature section looks unfinished.
overall_worst.fix: Give all 10 features one treatment. Either use borderless pairs throughout and move the two proof links to inline text links, or make every feature an equal-height card with its action pinned to the card bottom. Separately, remove the outer grey frame from the At the till figures and give all figures one width.
